section: The base / Employment income and sole-trader income
guide_wording: Increase the applicable bonus by 100% for an active worker with disability 33%–<65%, or by 250% for disability≥65% or 33%–<65% with the qualifying BLAM mobility limitation≥25%. The result cannot create negative employment income. Disability income status must be supported; do not apply the active-worker uplift solely because pension income exists.
